remarks: Nestled in the charming village of Albion, this colonial home offers a unique opportunity for visionaries and dreamers. Make this your next project with so much potential! The property features 2/3 bedrooms. The detached 1-car garage provides additional storage and off street parking. 1st floor laundry. Enclosed porch. Full unfinished basement for plenty of storage. While this property does need your personal touch, it has many possibilities to transform into your home or great investment. Convenient Village location with access to local amenities including shops, parks, and schools.
